items.s: Of 1,200 students, 45% slept under 6.5 hours; 12,345.67 and 1,000,000 were counted, 0.45 of them 7%, and 1,234.5% of nothing.
The correlation was r = .32, p < .05, not 0.32 or 32.
Scores fell from 28.4 to −3.5 points, a change of −12%.
As Steel and Lee (2007a) argued, delay is costly.
Findings agree with Rao et al., 2019, on this point.
शोधकर्ता ने लिखा “नींद की कमी” एक बड़ी समस्या है, और 120 छात्रों में से 45% ने इसे माना (शर्मा, 2019)।

She said “  The  Quick
Brown  Fox  ” and 'single' marks are not quotes.
See O’Brien, 2015 and Kumar & Rao, 2021, and Müller (2018).
